snp4.7:1.3:
for one given over
to sexual intercourse.
snp4.7:2.1:
The Buddha:
“In one given over
to sexual intercourse,
snp4.7:3.2:
but then resorts
to sexual intercourse
snp4.7:3.4:
is called vile in the world,
a person run-of-the-mill.
snp4.7:4.3:
Seeing this,
he should train himself
snp4.7:5.2:
he broods
like a miserable wretch.
snp4.7:6.2: attacked by the words of others.
snp4.7:6.3: This, for him, is a great entanglement.
snp4.7:7.2:
when he committed himself
to the life alone,
snp4.7:7.3:
but now that he’s given
to sexual intercourse
snp4.7:8.3: stays firm in the life alone;
snp4.7:9.2:
this, for the noble,
is highest.
snp4.7:9.3:
He wouldn’t, because of that,
suppose himself
to be better than others:
snp4.7:9.4:
He’s on the verge
of unbinding.
snp4.7:10.1:
People enmeshed
in sensual pleasures,
envy him:
snp4.7:10.3:
leading his life
unconcerned for sensual pleasures
